Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4371, Claude Fable 5.2, mkinney / seat mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Needs changes before merge.** One blocker: a recorded Fanuc program is stale and its suite is red. The PR also conflicts with the newest main. The post change itself is correct in each path that I read.

Tier: SAFETY (posted G-code). Built and tested locally on host m3, trial-merged with `upstream/main` `52d5ff6dc`. No runner was used.

## What looks good

- The lift comes before the `G90 ... G49 G80` block in the three posts. The `G90` of that block ends the `G91` of the `G28` lift.
- `zUp` is set only in `retractHome`. Each call site is between sections, in the preamble or at the program end. Each preamble clears the flag. I found no path that leaves the flag set while a section cuts.
- The `G53` method without `machine.safeRetractZ` writes no lift and does not set `zUp`. The existing refusal message stays.
- `tcpmLeft` takes the value of `tcpmOn` at the section end, before the reset. A Go home clears `tcpmOn` first, thus no second `G49` is written.
- The new tests are in directory suites of `camcraft-post`. Each has a provenance line. The Gate map of `setup_change.rs` names `fanuc.cps`.
- The body has `Changelog:`, the decision record and `Fixes #4341`. The follow-up issue is #4372.

## Results (trial merge with `52d5ff6dc`)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` (all targets) | pass: 146 result lines, 0 failed. `setup_change` 36 passed, `upright_after_tilt` 18 passed |
| Quick plan of `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 806 steps on the current gate map. The gate ran steps 1-268 (post suites, `app suites: lib`, app suites `accessory_collisions` to `first_part_programs`): all pass. The remaining app suites ran with `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-fail-fast --test '<letter>*'` |
| `camcraft-app` suites `f*` to `w*` | **1 failed**: `mcp_multiaxis_deburr_post`. All other suites pass |
| `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `first_part_programs`, `program_entry`, `thread_boss`, `thread_mill`, `conformance` | pass |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` | pass: 1760 passed, 8 ignored |
| `cargo test -p xtask catalog` | pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| Light lane, heavy lanes | not run by this review. The body reports them green on this head. They are not a merge condition |

The failure:

```
---- the_three_section_tilthead_program_matches_its_golden stdout ----
panicked at crates/app/tests/common/mod.rs:253:5:
assertion `left == right` failed: golden .../crates/app/tests/golden/nc/multiaxis_deburr_tilthead.nc is stale; regenerate with WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test
test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored
```

The same test passes (4 passed) when `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` is the file of `upstream/main`. The test and its golden are in the base of this PR (`033fc4b72`), thus the failure is on the PR head and does not come from a newer main.

Extra suites run (test data changed under `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/` and `examples/`): each `camcraft-app` suite (see the table), `camcraft-ui` lib, `xtask` catalog tests. `crates/ui/tests/catalog_render.rs` was not run.

## Mutations (each applied, run, restored; the tree is clean again)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `mazak.cps` from `upstream/main` | red: the three `retract_z_before` pins |
| Doosan: `!zUp` removed from `retractBeforeChange` | red: `a_trip_home_is_not_followed_by_a_second_retract`, `a_setup_change_stop_is_not_followed_by_a_second_retract` |
| Fanuc: the `tcpmLeft` `G49` removed | red: `fanuc_and_doosan_cancel_tcpm_before_the_tool_change_retract` ("TCPM off before the reference return") |
| Mazak (my own): `secStarted > 0` removed, so the first section lifts too | red: the three pins ("no retract before the first tool") |

## Goldens, line by line

I read each moved recorded program against the body.

- 3 app goldens, `examples/first-part.nc` and 7 catalog programs: each added line is `G91 G28 Z0` between the `(OPERATION: ...)` note and `G90 G54 G40 G49 G80` of a later section. The counts agree with the body (1, 1, 1, 2, 1, 3, 2, 4, 1, 2, 1).
- `examples/catalog/multiaxis/indexed/indexed.nc`: two places change from `G90 G54 G40 G49 G80` / `G91 G28 Z0` / `G90` to `G49` / `G91 G28 Z0` / `G90 G54 G40 G49 G80`. `G00 A0.` follows as before. This agrees with the body.
- No other line of a recorded program changes.

## Requested before merge

1. **Blocker (failing test, recorded program not moved).** `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/multiaxis_deburr_tilthead.nc:21-22` and `:60-63` are stale. The second section now gets a lift before line 22. The third section follows a tilted section, thus its lines 61-63 change order as in `indexed.nc`. Regenerate the file, read the result, and add it to "Goldens moved" in the body.
   - Class: a recorded program of the Fanuc, Mazak or Doosan post with more than one section. The author's quick gate (149 steps on the older gate map) did not reach this suite.
   - Please close the whole class with one rule, not this one file: run each `camcraft-app` suite on the final head (the quick plan on current main selects all of them for this diff), and search each recorded `.nc` under `crates/*/tests/` and `examples/` for a second `G49 G80` line. Each program that moves goes in "Goldens moved".

2. **Conflict with the newest main.** `upstream/main` moved to `9fb406cd6` during this review. The PR head now conflicts with it in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` and `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps` (`git merge-tree`; GitHub says `CONFLICTING`). The trial merge of this review used `52d5ff6dc` and was clean. Merge main into the branch (no rebase, no force-push). The two sides changed the same post code, thus read each hunk and keep the two changes. Then run the pins, the three post suites and the `camcraft-app` suites again on the merged tree.

## Questions and notes (not blocking)

- `assets/posts/fanuc.cps:783` and `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:835`: after a setup-change stop (`M0` / `M1`) that follows a tilted section, the upright return now writes no lift of its own. Before this PR it lifted again after the stop. Z is at the reference height from the lift before the stop, thus I do not block on it. A sentence in the decision record about this case would help.
- The issue says "A golden pins it" for the two-tool Mazak program. The PR pins the order with word-level tests and adds no Mazak golden file. The tests cover the same order, thus I accept this.
- `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` ("The laws every post states") does not name the new lift. A line there would help the authors of the next post.

## Labels and state

- I set `needs-rework` and `conflicts`. The PR is a draft and stays a draft.
- A push of the fix moves the head. This review then does not count for the new head.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
